name: claude-gemini-multimodal-bridge
stderr:
Usage: cgmb [options] [command]

Claude-Gemini Multimodal Bridge - Enterprise-grade AI integration tool

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  serve [options]                    Start the CGMB MCP server
  setup [options]                    Set up CGMB dependencies and configuration
  auth [options]                     Manage authentication for all services
  auth-status [options]              Check authentication status for all
                                     services
  quota-status [options]             Check Gemini API quota usage
  detect-paths [options]             Detect and show paths for required CLI
                                     tools
  setup-guide                        Show step-by-step authentication setup
                                     guide
  setup-mcp [options]                Configure Claude Code MCP integration for
                                     CGMB
  mcp-status                         Check Claude Code MCP configuration status
  verify [options]                   Verify CGMB installation and
                                     authentication
  test [options]                     Run a test multimodal processing request
  chat|c [options] [prompt...]       Chat with Gemini (user-friendly interface)
  gemini [options] [prompt...]       ⚠️  ADVANCED: Direct Gemini CLI access
                                     (troubleshooting only - use cgmb chat
                                     instead)
  aistudio [options]                 ⚠️  ADVANCED: Direct AI Studio access (use
                                     cgmb analyze instead for documents)
  process [options]                  Process multimodal content with
                                     intelligent layer routing
  generate-image [options] <prompt>  Generate an image using AI Studio
  generate-audio [options] <text>    Generate audio/speech from text using AI
                                     Studio
  analyze [options] <files...>       Analyze documents using AI Studio
  multimodal [options] <files...>    Process multiple files with AI (images,
                                     PDFs, audio, etc.)
  info [options]                     Show CGMB system information
  help [command]                     display help for command
